reviews.title: Loses system settings
reviews.text:
I am guessing it’s after an update or some obscure decision, but frequently the app settings switch back to the defaults. For example, Privacy Behavior, Takes Affect, Always Clear Data and Authenticate Bookmarks are settings that reset periodically and I have to set them back to my preferences. I would like a bookmark search that matches folder names and urls. Also, every now and then I open the app and my previous URL is lost and there is a blank value in the URL entry. Please keep track of the last URL so that when the app opens I can carry on when I left off. Address those and I’ll give you a 5.

Update 1/17/2026

Now I start reading some content and have scrolled down a few hundred words and stop reading. Come back a while later and the url I was reading is lost and the location I left it at too. What’s the point of a browser that I say do not clear anything, losing the url and position being read.
